description.value: Catch Kitchen + Bar is an upscale casual waterfront restaurant on the second floor of Bayview Pier at Fisherman's Wharf in historic Steveston Village, featuring a rooftop patio with a 270-degree panoramic view of the harbour and river inlet. The menu is seafood-forward with locally inspired dishes ranging from fresh crab cakes to peppercorn New York steak, alongside a sports lounge with seven HD screens. Steveston Village is a landmark stop on Richmond's popular cycling dyke routes, making this a natural destination for touring cyclists.
